exact_config.process_noise: None. Predict transforms physical means and corresponding full-factor rows; no inflation/forgetting.
exact_config.model: 3 Foster RC modes + R0; V=OCV(z)-R0*I-sum(v)-H*h. Positive current discharges; gamma units Ah^-1.
exact_config.OCV: 3+1.15*z+0.08*tanh(8*(z-0.5)); current candidate calls scm_ocv_eval(NULL,...). Illustrative known curve, not measured user OCV.
exact_config.measurement_semantics: Voltage is point sample at end of constant-current interval. Preserve actual dt and sample order.

current_generator_noise.voltage: iid N(0,0.001^2) V per sample at35Hz
current_generator_noise.current: Exact; no current noise or bias

public_initialization.mean_ln_tau: midpoints of ln-domain limits; physical tau=sqrt(lower*upper) by mode
public_initialization.covariance: Initially diagonal. SD=(upper-lower)/sqrt(12), with entering SOC width0.75 and entering v width0.16; no initial cross covariance.
public_initialization.split: Only lnQ: means mu +/- 0.7978845608028654*sigma; diagonal lnQ factor sigma*0.6028102749890869. Component0 lower mean. Other coordinates unchanged.
public_initialization.initial_evidence: No voltage evidence; prediction invalid, excitation0; zero clocks/index/counters.

weight_rule.score: From each pre-correction prediction: ell=-log(sd)-(0.5*(innovation/sd))*(innovation/sd). sd includes sigma_V and full predicted local covariance projection.
weight_rule.update: Only after all conditional transactions pass. Remove common max(score), add old normalized log weights, then stable log1p exp normalization. Exactly equal scores retain old log weights byte-for-byte.
weight_rule.retention: Keep both means/full factors and finite log weights; no pruning, merging, reseeding, covariance inflation, forgetting, floor/clipping, or posterior replay. Display exp(logw) may underflow without dropping a component.
weight_rule.missing_voltage: Both physical predictions carried once; weights and evidence cursors retained.
weight_rule.rejected_voltage: Whole-bank rollback of corrections/weights; both valid physical predictions and interval/accounting commit once.
weight_rule.uncertainty: Mixture local moment ranges and all-component hull are diagnostics only. Application SOC/Q accuracy remains uniformly unresolved; coverage unvalidated; no hard support.

output_metrics.SOC: weighted component current SOC using current normalized weights
output_metrics.Q: exp(sum_j w_j*mean_lnQ_j), a geometric center; not physical-space posterior expectation or mixture median
output_metrics.voltage_query: POST-correction component voltages averaged with POST-update weights. Label filtered fit, not one-step forecast.
output_metrics.causal_voltage_measurement: Host adapter captures old normalized weights before ingest; for successful voltage transaction, component last_innovation_V is the PRE-correction innovation. Causal mixture residual = sum_j old_w_j * innovation_j. Mixture forecast = observed V - that residual. Invalid/rejected/missing/recovery transaction has no successful pre-update diagnostic; capture separately.
output_metrics.error_scoring: Clean synthetic truth may score these outputs only in separate post-inference scorer. Preserve no-truth initialization/inference.

persistence.content: Both complete means and136-entry factors, both finite log weights, bank and per-component evidence cursors, source IDs/config, physical counters/clocks, masks/flags/diagnostics. CRC and structural/model/config validation.
persistence.restore: Decode into counted staged bank; successful restore is byte-exact and no assimilation. Failed restore preserves destination bytes.
persistence.cold_reset: Explicitly recreates public split and equal weights, sets epoch_begin=evidence cursor=existing next_index, clears evidence/excitation, marks HISTORY_LOST; retains physical stream position/clock and lifecycle counters. This is intentionally unsuitable inside a retention primary.
persistence.generator_checkpoint: No matching full plant/RNG/input-phase checkpoint in old generator. New continuous source is simpler than grafting extension onto CSV-bound source identity.
persistence.existing_fixture_scope: 188 checkpoint assertions;32 paired deterministic intervals (64 ingest deliveries), plus70-sample CLI whole versus35+35 fresh-process continuation. These are not a full second-cell lifecycle primary.
persistence.target_limit: Host atomic file write is not actual M23 NVM power-loss/ring-timing qualification.

accounting_and_failure.positive_accepted_recovery: Known interval consumed exactly once; old belief retained but not current; recovery/model unavailable flags. Do not auto cold-reset in primary.
accounting_and_failure.zero_return: Can still mean rejected voltage with valid physical prediction; check UPDATE_REJECTED flag and rejection stage, not only return code.
accounting_and_failure.bank_counts: One interval/voltage event, not two. Do not sum component sample counts.
accounting_and_failure.evidence: bank_evidence_next_index distinct from both conditional cursors. Weight-only accepted relative-weight update can advance bank evidence even when neither conditional gains moves.
accounting_and_failure.failure_stop_recommendation: Stop first negative ingest return, recovery, rejected-voltage flag, counter/source/index mismatch, nonfinite output/state, persistence mismatch, or budget breach; preserve first failure snapshot before any diagnostic adaptation.

minimum_new_harness.algorithm_changes: None required or authorized by design.
minimum_new_harness.adapter: New bounded continuous adapter (prefer leave frozen hypothesis_probe unchanged). Existing probe hard-caps --end73500 and entire validation/orchestrator pins73500 and2100s.
minimum_new_harness.stream_generator: Carry plant z,v,h, exact/global input index, phase cursor/elapsed, RNG bit-generator state including cached normal-generation state if applicable, and cumulative signed/absolute charge. One continuous generation; no phase reseeding or repeated observation history.
minimum_new_harness.generator_chunking: Pin RNG algorithm/version and call shape or test scalar/chunk equivalence explicitly. Freeze chunk size if reproducibility needs it. Existing np.random.default_rng hides algorithm/version choice and draws full arrays.
minimum_new_harness.source_identity: Use immutable complete experiment/config/source stream identity; do not change source_id at phases. Source provenance hash and generated-stream digest can be distinct fields.
minimum_new_harness.streaming_interfaces: Generator emits only sample_index,dt,current,voltage to estimator; truth records sent to separate scoring artifact, never estimator process.
minimum_new_harness.instrumentation: Retain old weights for causal voltage; log bounded summaries and full state only at predeclared endpoints/failure. No diagnostics change inference.
minimum_new_harness.continuation_gate: Tiny split-run versus uninterrupted generator+estimator fixture compares future sample bytes, RNG/plant state, clocks/index and final canonical learner checkpoint, including a phase boundary. Existing estimator-only checkpoint fixtures do not cover coupled generator continuation.

recommended_gates: Freeze complete candidate source blobs and new harness source, compiler flags, binary, config/plan and stream identity before primary.
Use prior core/codec qualification as evidence; rerun targeted short fixtures only for new adapter/generator behavior and no need to rerun old cell studies.
Verify generator carry across phase and chunk boundaries with independently evaluated one-dwell closed forms; do not use truth to correct learner.
Verify full coupled warm continuation on a short constructed fixture with exact generated future samples and canonical estimator checkpoint parity.
Verify unavailable, missing, rejected and recovery records cannot silently count as accurate or zero error.
Keep full-fidelity means/factors/log weights through all primary phases; no collapse or resets.
Add a short second-cell/lifecycle gate before treating longer B evidence as broader qualification; do not infer duration sufficiency or generalization from cellB alone.
open_limits: Historical17 cold-reset rejection causes still unattributed.
No actual M23 full-system memory/timing/NVM qualification.
No drift, temperature, current-bias, quantization or model-mismatch claim.
No coverage confidence from one trajectory's correlated query inclusion count.
